evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/ConfirmationDialog.tsx:76-90 — the Tab focus-trap for this aria-modal="true" alertdialog collects focusable children with querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])') (:77-79). When the confirm action is in flight BOTH action buttons render disabled={isLoading} (:136 cancel, :144 confirm) and the dialog/overlay carry no tabindex, so the selector matches ZERO elements: firstElement/lastElement are undefined (:80-81) and the shift/!shift guards at :83-88 can never be true, so the trap silently no-ops and native Tab moves focus OUT of the open modal to the background page. Compounding it, the initial-focus effect keyed on [isOpen] (:57-66) does not re-run when isLoading flips, so the cancel button it focused (:61) becomes disabled and focus falls to <body> for the whole latency window. Net effect: a WCAG 2.1.2/2.4.3 keyboard-trap/focus-order defect on every confirmation with a non-instant onConfirm (delete / danger API calls are exactly the latency case). NET-NEW: the only prior ConfirmationDialog findings are i18n (confirmLabel/cancelLabel defaults, 'Processing...'); the 2026-08-28 ppt-web-ui pass explicitly re-reviewed this file and recorded 'focus trap + Escape + focus restore all present' — i.e. it checked the non-loading path and MISSED the isLoading edge. Severity low (a11y, no crash); confidence medium (statically confirmed from the selector + disabled attributes, not runtime-reproduced). Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): keep at least one focusable control reachable while loading (e.g. don't disable cancel, or make the dialog container tabindex=0 and focus it), or guard the trap so an empty focusable set re-focuses the dialog instead of releasing Tab.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/pages/AuthCallbackPage.tsx:138-146 — the SSO code-exchange catch block does `err instanceof Error ? err.message : t('auth.ssoCallbackFailed')`, so whenever loginWithSsoCode() rejects with a plain Error the RAW err.message is stored in errorMessage and rendered verbatim in the error banner (:191-196, `{errorMessage}`). On the sk/cs/de locales this surfaces untranslated English/developer text on the primary SSO auth surface, and leaks whatever internal/network detail the thrown Error carries (e.g. a fetch/axios message or backend error string) to the end user. This is the SAME raw-backend-message anti-pattern already filed for LoginPage.tsx:80-86 (login-raw-message) and errorboundary-raw-message-prod / emergency-dir-raw-err / signature-modal-raw-err, but is NET-NEW for AuthCallbackPage: the only prior finding on this file is the unguarded decodeURIComponent at :93; grep for AuthCallbackPage raw/err.message/138/141 across .research/signals + backlog.json returned no prior hit. Severity low (i18n/UX consistency + minor internal-detail disclosure, no crash — React escapes the text so no injection); confidence medium (literal statically confirmed). Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): render a translated generic fallback (t('auth.ssoCallbackFailed') / t('auth.unexpectedError')) for unmapped errors and map known AuthError codes, instead of echoing err.message — mirroring the fix proposed for the LoginPage sibling finding.
